scope: Freeze the Newton robustness, line-search, stagnation, adaptive-control and deterministic replay contract before WP03 implementation.

canonical_equations.diagnostic_residual: R(u, lambda, state) = lambda * F_ext - F_internal - F_contact
canonical_equations.normalization: Global convergence uses the free-DOF residual; fixed DOFs are constrained in the reduced solve and do not enter the physical residual norm.
canonical_equations.sign_policy: Existing internal force and tangent signs may remain inside formulation-specific assembly. The common driver normalizes diagnostics only and must not change physical force definitions.
canonical_equations.load_factor_ownership: The accepted composite state owns the published load factor. Adaptive and arc controllers may propose next-trial policy values, but they cannot publish them before global acceptance.
canonical_equations.contribution_accumulation: Material, geometric and contact contributions are accumulated through NonlinearAssemblyProtocol/CompositeNonlinearAssembly; the driver does not inspect constitutive or contact equations.

public_fixed_newton.observation: solve_full_newton is a compatibility adapter; the global fixed-load Newton lifecycle is executed by UnifiedNewtonEngine.

accepted_state_and_transaction.observation: Migrated fixed, adaptive and arc-length routes publish accepted composite state through the shared transaction boundary.

adaptive_load_control.observation: Both paths use the unified transaction/driver foundation, but retain separate adaptive increment, cutback and growth policy implementations pending WP03.

arc_length.observation: Arc-length retains an augmented correction kernel and radius policy, while accepted state and rollback use the shared continuation controller.

experimental_robustness.observation: Experimental linear solver, permutation, scaling and line-search controls are explicit opt-in R&D controls, not the default public robustness authority.

contact_boundary.public: NonlinearStaticSolver validates the common nonlinear contact route as frictionless penalty contact only.
contact_boundary.observation: Active-set, frictional and slip-root loops are not part of the public common nonlinear driver and must not be promoted by WP03.

duplicate_policy_surfaces.required_outcome: One authoritative line-search dispatch and one documented merit/acceptance contract; compatibility wrappers delegate.
One formulation-neutral retry/cutback/growth policy with physical accepted state separated from next-trial policy state.
Retain augmented mathematics, but expose radius retry/growth decisions through the common robustness diagnostics and failure contract.
Keep opt-in and bounded; do not make experimental settings silently alter the public default.

target_authority.name: UnifiedNonlinearRobustnessController
target_authority.relationship_to_arc_length: Arc-length may keep a specialized augmented correction kernel and radius proposal. The common controller owns accepted/rejected lifecycle, failure classification, rollback boundary and diagnostics, not the arc algebra.

secondary_measures: optional energy/work norm when the route provides it
stagnation_contract.decision_rule: Declare CONVERGENCE_STAGNATION only when the canonical convergence criteria are not satisfied and the residual has failed to decrease across the declared window by the required relative amount.
determinism_rules: No wall-clock, thread timing or unordered diagnostic data may affect the decision.
The exact residual history, window and threshold belong in diagnostics.
A non-finite value takes precedence and maps to NAN_DETECTED or INF_DETECTED.
stagnation_contract.current_implementation_note: UnifiedNewtonEngine currently uses a four-sample residual plateau check with a 1e-10 relative threshold. WP03-B must make that behavior explicit and test false-positive/false-negative boundaries before changing it.

line_search_contract.reduction: Geometric halving after a rejected trial.
line_search_contract.acceptance: Accept the first finite trial satisfying strict merit decrease by default; an explicitly configured Armijo coefficient c uses M(alpha) <= (1 - c * alpha) M(0).
line_search_contract.failure: If no finite trial is accepted within the reduction budget or alpha floor, return LINE_SEARCH_FAILURE and leave the accepted state unchanged.
line_search_contract.arc_boundary: The augmented arc-length correction may use its specialized kernel; it must not create a second accepted-state or retry authority.

rules: Only an accepted composite transaction may advance physical state.
A rejected trial is discarded before cutback is applied.
A second retry starts from the same accepted digest as the first retry.
MIN_INCREMENT_REACHED is an explicit terminal outcome.
Checkpoint failure is infrastructure failure and never causes a physical cutback by default.

arc_length_boundary.prohibited: Do not force the standard fixed-load Newton equation onto arc-length or allow arc-length to publish an accepted state outside the shared transaction.

public_default: modified Newton through the common load-control lifecycle
bounded adaptive load-control routes once their existing route contract is preserved
frictionless penalty composition within its existing bounded scope
public_and_experimental_policy.maturity_rule: WP03 implementation and robustness improvements do not change qualification or public maturity. Any future promotion requires the separate capability gates and Owner approval.

frozen_thresholds.deterministic_replay: Exact state and diagnostic digest equality where the route is deterministic; otherwise the permitted physical threshold above and an explicit reason for non-bitwise variation.
frozen_thresholds.existing_stricter_tests: Existing repository tolerances remain authoritative when stricter.

owner_decisions.OD-029-01: OPEN; formulation decision remains outside WP03 and blocks WP09 only.
